# TUROS documentation (https://www.turos.app/docs)
#
# This file overrides Mintlify's auto-generated robots.txt. Mintlify's default
# advertised "Content-Signal: ai-train=yes, search=yes, ai-input=yes", which
# contradicted the AI-training signal published at the root of the same brand
# (https://www.turos.app/robots.txt). The Content-Signal below is copied
# verbatim from the root so both surfaces state one policy.
#
# Content signal semantics (Cloudflare Content Signals Policy):
#   search:   building a search index and returning links/short excerpts.
#   ai-input: feeding content into AI models at request time (RAG, grounding).
#   ai-train: training or fine-tuning AI models.
#   use:      how AI systems may consume the content.
# ANY RESTRICTIONS EXPRESSED VIA CONTENT SIGNALS ARE EXPRESS RESERVATIONS OF
# RIGHTS UNDER ARTICLE 4 OF THE EUROPEAN UNION DIRECTIVE 2019/790 ON COPYRIGHT
# AND RELATED RIGHTS IN THE DIGITAL SINGLE MARKET.

User-agent: *
Content-Signal: search=yes,ai-train=no,use=reference
Allow: /
Disallow: /cdn-cgi/
Allow: /_next/image
Disallow: /_next/

# Training / broad model-development crawlers: disallowed, matching the root.
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: Amazonbot
Disallow: /

User-agent: meta-externalagent
Disallow: /

# AI search / user-directed retrieval crawlers stay allowed, matching the root.
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-User
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Perplexity-User
Allow: /

Sitemap: https://www.turos.app/docs/sitemap.xml
